name: Content Agent
description: Turns every new YouTube upload into a full content drop: extracts podcast audio, generates short clips, drafts the podcast episode with chapters, queues everything for two-step review, and publishes approved assets across platforms. Watches the channel automatically — no manual kickoff needed.
tagline: Every upload becomes clips, a podcast, and posts — automatically.

podcast_brand.label: Podcast brand name (e.g. 'Positively American with Braden Langley')

podcast_publish_mode.label: Episode delivery: 'manual' (package to Dropbox; creator uploads to Podbean) or 'rss' (self-hosted public feed)

publish_deadline_local.label: Daily publish target (local time) — assets should be live by this time

podcast_min_minutes.label: Minimum live-stream length (minutes) that becomes a podcast episode

copy_style_guide.label: Style guide for AI-drafted titles/captions/hashtags (tone, phrases to use/avoid)

escalation_slack_channel_id.label: Slack channel ID for failure alerts (goes to the owner, not the reviewer)
